services.name: Checkmat Jiu Jitsu Organization
services.desc: Founded in 2008, Checkmat was born out of a passion to create a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu team rooted in family, positivity, and excellence. Today, that same passion lives on through 200+ schools worldwide, shaping a genuine and supportive global community of BJJ practitioners. Checkmat is one of the most successful teams in the history of competitive Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu. Despite being a relatively young team, it has made a powerful impact on the global BJJ scene with numerous world championship titles and a strong international presence in over 16 countries. services.desc: In the XK2 program, students begin to develop a deeper understanding of the art of Jiu-Jitsu and its broader aspects from self-defense to competition training developing your child into a martial artist and continuing the path of a lifelong learner. Jiu-Jitsu incorporates a lot of ground grappling and is based in automatic human responses. When it comes to self-defense, BJJ empowers a smaller individual to fight against a larger opponent. But the advantages don’t stop there. BJJ helps kids gain confidence, learn discipline, focus their energy, foster respect for others, and be a part of a one-of-a-kind community full of future friends and mentors!
